note: GUI 3's port ledger (ADR-333, ROADMAP B593): everything not yet moved over into the shell, where it lives today and why it has not moved. Seeded 2026-10-30 from the human's list (their words in `asked`), plus the gaps found in the shell. A row leaves only when its item ships in the shell. tools/gen_gui3_controls.py --check holds every row to a reason from `reasons`, a sentence, a source path that exists (or "nowhere yet"), a ROADMAP row and a status; `partial` names what is missing. `precise` marks an item the human asked to be copied precisely, not re-derived.

reasons.engine-audio: waiting on the engine or audio

rows.item: Deeper morph interface with parameter boundaries (the quantum boundaries, the waypoints, the blend maps)
rows.asked: Deeper morph interface with parameter boundaries
rows.why: The morph editor's rounds (B268, B269) and the architecture-follows-the-morph proposal (B585) are not ratified; the Morph page's design is B581 step 3.
rows.missing: The shell's Morph page has D.2's settings, the corners and snapshots; the large pad, the quantum boundaries, the cross-section and the blend maps are not there.

rows.item: The Randomize panel (levels, chaos and amount, locks, randomization presets, copying a level between corners)
rows.asked: Random page interface (whether we fold it into morph or keep it)
rows.why: ADR-322 folds it into the Morph page; the Random lab's next round (ADR-320, ADR-321, ADR-322 item 1) is still being ruled, so the shell shows a placeholder card.

rows.item: The Settings page
rows.why: What is broken: the Set tab opens nothing. Its page bar group is `set` with one page whose id is `settings`; a one-page group in Page nav is its own page (id `set`), so a click asks the shell for page `set`, which does not exist, and the page stays as it was. The hash `#settings` opens it. Its content is two Device rows (polyphony, quality); the settings lab and file manager (B261) are not designed.
rows.missing: The Set tab's click (one line in the shell's page bar build, slice 5's out of scope), and every setting beyond polyphony and quality.

rows.item: Gain staging on the mixer (a meter and a clip warning at every stage, the gain bars)
rows.why: The Gain staging component exists in the design system (B544, B549); it reads every tap's peak and latch, which the engine publishes per stage (IF-6, RC-8) and the stub cannot; the mixer's ranges wait on RC-2 (B402).

rows.item: All the oscillator visualizers: the Kuramoto ring with its circular representation of the blades, the phase carpet, the voice map, the members-at-phase view, the R-hued beam
rows.asked: All osc visualizers (scalpel, phase carpet, etc.) - and the ones recently added didn't port over the full capability of the kuro visualizer from the scalpel lab, with its circular representation of blade, etc.; I really liked the aesthetics and functionality from the scalpel lab and would like to copy it pretty precisely
rows.why: They draw the engine's rendered state (RC-8: members' phases, each blade's window, the frame angle); the shell has no audio, so the ring today is a SAMPLE drawing without the blades' rim arcs, the click-to-set XY or the carpet. To be copied precisely from the bench, not re-derived (ADR-333).
rows.missing: The bench's ring as drawn (blade arcs on the rim, cross-mod arrows, the XY gesture), the phase carpet, the voice map, members at phase, the R-hued beam.

rows.item: The Specimen XY on Main (the XY pad over the Specimen, ADR-139)
rows.asked: Specimen XY from the scalpel lab on main
rows.why: The Specimen is voice-bound: it draws what the voices render (ADR-262 ruling 1), so it waits on audio; to be copied precisely from the bench (ADR-333).

rows.item: Almost everything else from Main (the performance page: the pad, the macros, the Specimen, the voice's performance controls)
rows.why: Main's design is B581 step 2; the shell's Main has the voice and ENV 1 only.
rows.missing: The pad as Main's centre, the macros, the Specimen, the output section; the voice and ENV 1 are there.

rows.item: The bend law section with its visuals, as in horde legacy (the bend graphs, glide, the scale quantizer)
rows.asked: Bend law section with visuals, a la horde legacy (not sure where is best)
rows.why: The pitch system is a reserved contract (RC-3), outside SPEC-ENGINE 5: its bend, glide and quantizer rows have no table yet (B586), and where the section belongs is the human's open question.

rows.item: The filters (two per voice, Weir's types)
rows.why: The filters move to Weir (B567, ADR-307); Weir has no machine-readable manifest yet, so the Filters page lists none (RC-1).

rows.item: The FX modules' screens and their morph and modulation states
rows.why: How morph and modulation show on a module's glass is B591's design; Echo, Scape, Shriek and Bulwark's parameters are in the shell as house-style DOM views since slice 4a.
rows.missing: Each module's own screen (a labelled placeholder today), the chain view, and Sluice and Weir, which have no manifest.

rows.item: Sluice's controls
rows.why: No machine-readable manifest found in Sluice's tree (2026-10-30), so nothing is generated for it.

rows.item: All the modulators: the LFOs, the modulator family's editors, the mod matrix and its routes page
rows.why: The LFOs, the matrix and every route are deferred from the engine (RC-4) and have no rows in a table (B586 drafts one); the shell has ENV 2 to ENV 4, the bank and its map handle.
rows.missing: The LFOs and the other modulators, the matrix, the routes page; ENV 1 to ENV 4 and the bank are there.

rows.item: The quick map selector at the top (the persistent MAP control and its source selector)
rows.asked: The quick map selector at the top, from one of the recent labs
rows.why: The Map Mode spec's persistent MAP control is the design system's MapControl; no recent lab in docs/design mounts it, so which lab the human means is a question. The shell maps by the bank's handle today; the mod map is B581 step 1.

rows.item: The History page (the undo tree, the rail graph, coalescing)
rows.why: The shell keeps a flat undo stack in the adapter; the page bar omits Hist because no page exists.

rows.item: The per-parameter morph mode (Follow, Quantum, Exempt) on every morphing control
rows.why: B557's open questions (what Exempt holds, Quantum on a structural row) are not ruled; D.4 (MO-11) states each key's mode in the spec.

rows.item: Macros and the intent bus (the bank's Macros view)
rows.why: The macros and the intent bus are deferred from the engine (RC-4) and have no rows; the bank's Macros switch says so.

rows.item: Parameter descriptions in the info box (the `desc` column)
rows.why: No `desc` column exists for horde 2's parameters; the info box shows each row's spec text and counts the gap (317 of 317).

rows.item: Right-click "Open in manual" opening the manual at the control
rows.why: The manual's HTML pages and their per-control anchors (B451) do not exist; the menu item is a stub.

rows.item: Arp's page placement
rows.why: The ruled page set has no Arp page; it sits under Mod as a draft until the human rules.
rows.missing: A ruled place and a designed page; its 47 settings are generated and reachable.

rows.item: Sound: the WebAssembly engine behind the seam (meters, scopes and the voice-bound views become real)
rows.why: The WebAssembly build waits for the clean room's stage 8 (IF-10, ADR-280); until then every meter, scope and spectrum in the shell is MOCK or SAMPLE.
